clips.title: The story
paras: Cragpool Lake is a body of water tucked inside Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Looming above its dark waters sits a massive timber structure erected by the Venture Company, while the depths below harbor a notoriously aggressive beast.

Nestled deep within Windshear Crag, Cragpool Lake lies directly beneath the towering logging apparatus built by the Venture Company. An enormous wooden structure spans above the water, once serving as the prime vantage point from which Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle commanded clear-cutting operations across the mountain valley. While much of the syndicate has scaled back their presence in the crag, holdouts and sentries linger across the catwalks and platforms overhead. Down below, the lake has been declared strictly off-limits by the goblins due to the arrival of Cragjaw, a massive and predatory fish prowling the murky water beneath the gears.
